Name: Custom Locks
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you do the following:

[list]
[*]enter Pierre's store on Wednesdays
[*]enter places outside of the hours normally allowed
[*]enter homes as a stranger if you'd normally be barred as a stranger
[*]enter bedrooms and the Wizard's basement as a stranger
[*]ignore locked places during events (sort of, experimental)
[/list]

[b]Settings:[/b] (in the mod's config.json file):

[list]
[*][b]Enabled[/b]: [i]true[/i], set to false to completely disable this mod.
[*][b]AllowSeedShopWed[/b]: [i]true[/i], allows you to enter Pierre's store on Wednesdays.
[*][b]AllowOutsideTime[/b]: [i]true[/i], allows you to enter places outside of the hours normally allowed.
[*][b]AllowStrangerHomeEntry[/b]: [i]false[/i], allows you to enter homes as a stranger if and when you'd normally be barred as a stranger.
[*][b]AllowStrangerRoomEntry[/b]: [i]false[/i], allows you to enter bedrooms and the Wizard's basement as  a stranger.
[*][b]AllowAdventureGuildEntry[/b]: [i]false[/i], allows you to enter the adventure guild before being accepted.
[*][b]IgnoreEvents[/b]: [i]false[/i], allows you to ignore locked places during events (maybe, experimental)
[/list]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
